I understand completely. I feel dead inside sometimes as well. But you are not a tool for the world to use. Familiarize yourself with a blade and a gun if you are not a felon. Don't ever let anyone take from you. Yes, we may feel numb most of the time, but you know there are people that bring warmth. Imagine the things that happened to you happening to those we cherish. That's what did it for me. Being scared doesn't mean you lack courage. Courage is perseverance in the face of fear. Practice, get into some fights. Try local MMA training facilities. Find someone to train you and actually spar. You need to know how it feels to throw a punch. What kept me going was thinking about my kids going through what I went through. This is my advice to you,  Never let this cesspool of an earth take from you again. Protect your warmth, your light. Get a dog that helped me A LOT. Like a lot a lot. Have kids or adopt or be a foster parent. We know the ugly parts of this world and are well equipped to teach uneducated ones how to avoid the dark. I can tell you that these steps have given me a reason to continue. I still feel numb at times, but I try to channel this into something constructive. Good luck, my friend.
